about: One shot list for the 15s, 30s and ~60s cuts (CTX-408.7). Each shot says how long it runs in each cut; a cut that does not list a shot drops it. Captions carry the whole story, with no sound. A caption that states a number is checked against the source frame it came from by scripts/check_shotlist.py. Crops are [x, y, width, height] in the source capture's own pixels.

shots.notes: The board in KiCad's PCB editor, dark. A slow push-in. No number, no pullout.

captions.text: Your breadboard works.
Now make it a real board.

shots.notes: KiCad's own DRC dialog. The violation line is the same one segment 4 explains, and its numbers match the app's.

pullouts.highlight: min annular width 0.1000 mm; actual 0.0850 mm

captions.text: This is where a lot of projects stop.

shots.notes: Base crop starts below the 'Where you are' card, which says the board has been checked and would contradict the caption. The pullout is an editorial camera move over a still with no pointer in it; the caption claims only that nothing beyond opening the project was done.

pullouts.highlight: Its own 5V pin (pin 5) is not connected to anything.

captions.text: Open the project. Nothing else.
It already read the board.
+5V is on VIN. The 5V pin is unconnected.
It asks: is that what you meant?

shots.notes: Header from pcb-02 (fresh check, KiCad's defaults), then the summary and the first annular card from pcb-03. The two numbers are the ones segment 2's dialog shows.

pullouts.highlight: KiCad reports 4 design-rule violations, 1 unconnected item.
four annular-width errors on D1's pads
min annular width 0.1000 mm; actual 0.0850 mm

captions.text: Same files. Same checks as KiCad.
Then it says what they mean.
Copper ring: 0.085 mm. Minimum: 0.100 mm.
Thin enough for the drill to break it.

shots.notes: The origin line in copper, then the D1 card. The review's repeated DRC findings (a known defect) stay out of frame.

pullouts.highlight: 2 of these were found by Copperplane. ERC and DRC do not report them.

captions.text: Then, what no check reports.
A symbol with 2 pins.
A footprint with 4 pads.
No rule was broken.
It was never going to work.

shots.notes: The measured-height callout, then the real orbit from take A (motion measured at 8.5-11.3 s).

captions.text: It sizes a case from your board.
Needs 14.1 mm inside. Set by D1.
And says what it couldn't measure.

shots.notes: Two real captures side by side, presented as two windows: KiCad unchanged, Copperplane beside it.

captions.text: It reads your files.
It doesn't take them over.

shots.notes: Stacked lockup on dark (brand/png/lockup-stacked-on-dark-1200.png), with the site URL set as part of the card, not as a caption.

captions.text: Free. Open. Runs on your machine.
